description: USENSYS, published by usensys, optimizes long-term United States energy-system capacity expansion using R and energyRt. Coverage: The model targets the United States and currently focuses on electricity. Several 26-zone, state-level and imported-model variants are described as in preparation, not all as completed releases. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is AGPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The package and documentation are under development. Large instances can require commercial solvers and substantial memory. Planned non-electric sectors and interfaces must not be treated as delivered. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
